email.subject: Quick fix for Summit Group's site
email.body:
Marcus,

Looked at Summit Group Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no way to book online, so anyone searching after hours has to wait and call a competitor instead. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open now or during a cold snap emergency.

Both are quick fixes. I run a one-person shop fixing exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why?

Alex
Northlight Web
